I rebuilt the Meal plan page so it fits an iPhone screen with no sideways scrolling. The old page used a fixed 900px-wide table. I haven't opened it on a phone, so check it under Page in the note.

Each day is now its own card. The card lists Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack and Notes. Days where Shop is "Yes" get a small "Shop" badge. Today's card has an amber outline. It uses the app's colours, so dark mode works.

Your note's table is unchanged. I left out empty Notes cells, so those rows are blank on the card. The previous version of the page is kept if you want it back.
